tools.name: machines
tools.description: Lists the machines Claude can reach through Latchkey: each one's name, whether it's a Mac or a Linux server, whether it's online (or when it was last seen), and the tools it offers. Call it when you don't know which machine to use; then pass the name as machine to the other tools.

tools.name: shell_run
tools.description: Runs a command in the Mac owner's login shell (zsh), as them, never as administrator. Waits up to wait seconds (default and most 30); a longer command keeps running as a job (check it with shell_check). With job and input: types input into that job (then Enter unless enter is false). With job and stop: stops it (Ctrl-C, then forcibly). A command writes only to its own scratch folder ($LATCHKEY_SCRATCH, also $TMPDIR; moved to the Trash when it finishes), the folder it runs in (unless that is the home folder), Downloads, and package caches; anything else fails unless declared in writes (with why), and so does changing settings (defaults write: declare ~/Library/Preferences/<domain>.plist). Opening apps, files, or links through macOS (open) fails unless declared in uses; scripting other apps (osascript) and starting background services (launchctl, brew services) aren't possible. Whatever it leaves running is stopped when it finishes, unless keep_minutes asks to keep it (checking the job keeps it longer; 24 hours at most).

enter.description: With input: press Enter after (default true)

job.description: A running job's id, to type into or stop

keep_minutes.description: Keep what the command leaves running (a server, a watcher) and its scratch folder this many minutes after it finishes (0 to 1440, default 0)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

uses.description: What the command does beyond the fence, only when the owner's task needs it: open (apps, files, links through macOS). What it starts runs outside the fence and keeps running.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for it to finish (1 to 30, default 30)

why.description: With writes: what the command writes there, for the owner's list

writes.description: Folders or files outside the allowed places the command will write (full paths or ~/...); results meant to stay

tools.name: shell_check
tools.description: With job: shows that job's new output since the last check and whether it has finished, waiting up to wait seconds; for a job whose leftovers are kept, checking keeps them longer. Without: lists running jobs, those whose leftovers are kept, and those finished in the last 10 minutes.

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for more output or the end (0 to 30, default 10)

tools.name: files_find
tools.description: Finds files on the Mac. With query: searches names and contents with Spotlight, newest first (inside path, if given). Without query: lists the folder at path (the home folder if empty), or shows a file's details. Paths may start with ~; others are taken from the home folder. Spotlight skips hidden and excluded folders; list those instead.

limit.description: When searching: at most this many files (default 30, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

path.description: The folder to list or search in, or a file to describe

query.description: Words in the file's name or content

tools.name: contacts_find
tools.description: Searches the Mac's Contacts by name, nickname, company, email address, or phone number, with each card's id. With id: the card in full (phones, emails, addresses, birthday, dates, web addresses, related names, groups); with photo: true, its picture. With nothing: the groups and how many contacts there are.

group.description: Only cards in this group (name or id)

id.description: A card's id, to read it in full

limit.description: At most this many cards (default 20, up to 100)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

photo.description: With id: show the card's picture

query.description: Words in a name, company, or email, or a phone number

tools.name: messages_send
tools.description: Sends a message from the Mac's Messages app: text, files, or both. to is a name from Contacts, a phone number, an email address, a group's name, or a conversation id from messages_find. Attachments are paths of files on the Mac. If a name matches several people or numbers, nothing is sent and the choices are returned.

attachments.description: Paths of files on the Mac to send

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

to.description: Who or which conversation to send to
